cause_assessment.reason: A 250 ms lock failure should have raised a retained Python exception promptly; the attempt instead ran for tens of seconds and emitted no exception transcript.
The retained tool timing ended before the configured 60-second monotonic deadline and no SQLite interrupted exception was retained.

The process disappeared without normal output or exception, the index is absent, no rollback journal remains and production recovered cleanly; neither the runner nor OS retained a definitive termination record.
The C11 one-off runner did not durably record phase transitions, exception identity, deadline callback, rollback completion or exit status.

smallest_coherent_next_milestone: Fixture-qualify a durable single-index deployment runner that records append-only phase, deadline, exception, rollback, close and postcondition events before separately authorizing any retry.
